title: OpenAI Codex CLI
denyMechanism: sandbox policy (`--sandbox read-only|workspace-write`) + approval policy in config.toml; no per-skill tool allowlist. `agents/openai.yaml` `policy.allow_implicit_invocation: false` disables implicit invocation

listing.budget: skills list ≤ 2 % of context or 8 000 chars
listing.note: name + description drive implicit matching; the full SKILL.md loads when selected regardless of budget

degradations.text: skill `allowed-tools` is informational — Codex enforces nothing per skill; only the sandbox/approval policy restricts
a Claude-style agent `tools:` allowlist has no TOML counterpart and is dropped when rendered to .codex/agents/*.toml
`disable-model-invocation` has no effect; use `agents/openai.yaml` policy.allow_implicit_invocation: false
